newsitem.title: USA: Cellular Technical target of suit - lawyers.
newsitem.headline: Cellular Technical target of suit - lawyers.

text.p: Attorneys for purchasers of the common stock of Cellular Technical Services Inc during a seven-and-a-half month period said Monday a class action lawsuit was filed against the company.

The complaint alleges the company and certain of its officers and directors issued false and misleading financial and business information, which caused the market price of the company's common stock to be artificially inflated.
The complaint also alleges this caused the plaintiffs and other class members to pay too much for their common stock of the company.
The company was not immediately available to comment.
The complaint was filed in the U.S. District Court for the Western District of Washington. The class period is between Nov. 14, 1996 and June 30, 1997.
The plaintiffs, represented by the law firm of Wolf Haldenstein Adler Freeman & Herz LLP, are seeking to recover damages on behalf of class members.
